speaker: davy_gannet
text: Westward ho. Old Swan, and the flood under us. Twopence a man, and each man his own. I do not keep a company's score.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Twopence. I have it. I am first in the boat, as I mean to be first on the paper.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art first because thou stepped in before the rope was fast. Sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence. That is mine. Dick pays Dick.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Three of you. I can count to three. I have carried men who could not.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Is Raleigh crowned by now? They say Guiana has made a king of him.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Crowned, and the gold already tired of being gold. I had it of a man who had it of a man at the sail.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have the flood, Davy. That I can see. Outer stair at Whitehall, and no further.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Whitehall stairs, and not a foot of palace. A waterman who lands a player in the wrong court loses both.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: An hour in a passage is what these mornings are. I have stood in passages.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I shall stand where the clerk can read me. First.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The warrant names three of us. It does not name an order of standing.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Twopence, and I have them. If the tide turns while you are inside, do not ask me for a new river.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I will not pay a river for changing its mind.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nor I. If we walk, we walk. Lent has been teaching us our legs all week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Strand and Holborn are a walk. The palace is not a place we are going.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: I will put you where the clerks are. There will be a tailor, and men with trumpets, also waiting. You will not see a chair of state from there.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have seen chairs. I want the bag.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The bag is the Queen's until a clerk says otherwise. Twopence does not buy a speech. Sit.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: It buys the flood. The flood is worth it. Gentlemen argue with the tide, and the tide charges them nothing and ignores them.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we shall not argue. Westward.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let the tailor and the trumpets be ahead of us in the passage. We are not late for a play.

speaker: will_kemp
text: We are late for Christmas. They are paying it in Lent. I shall look grateful, and be first.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Grateful is extra. The fare is twopence. Hold on. She knows the tide better than a warrant does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold her, then. The twopence is in your hand. I have no more business with the river until the tide says so.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And if it says otherwise when we come out, we already know the road.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I know it. I will still prefer a boat, at twopence, while the flood lasts.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Then prefer it quietly. Westward ho.
